name: Phenacetin

own_problems.text: Pulled from the market in United States and 36 other countries, first in 1965 — for blood problems and kidney harm

similar.name: Acetaminophen
problems: Carries a boxed warning in United States — for misuse or addiction, liver harm and kidney harm

similar.name: Clofibrate
problems: Pulled from the market in Israel and 2 other countries, first in 1979 — for blood vessel problems and cancer risk

fda.text: In case of overdose, get medical help or contact a Poison Control Center right away. If pregnant or breast-feeding , ask a healthcare professional before use. Keep out of reach of children.

summary: Phenacetin was removed from the market in the United States and 36 other nations due to kidney harm and blood problems [3]. Based on a small computer model rather than tests on people, it received low risk scores for both the liver and heart [M]. Warnings on its label advise keeping it away from children, consulting a healthcare professional if pregnant or breast-feeding, and contacting a Poison Control Center immediately if an overdose occurs [5].
